units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 9:1:7">Y. Ned. IX, beg. 41ᵇ</cite> <he>אין היצר הרע ת׳ אלא וכ׳</he> the evil inclination has a desire only for what is forbidden; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 6:4:5">Y. Yoma VI, 43ᵈ</cite> top <cite ref="V00772"><he>תָּעֵב</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Arakhin 4:26">Tosef. Arakh. IV, 26</cite> <he>והוא ת׳ לו</he> (not <he>והלא</he>) while he has an appetite for it. Y. Ber. VII, 11ᵃ bot. <he>מה אם … שהוא ת׳ לאכול וכ׳</he> if man must bless God after he has eaten and is satisfied, how much more must he do so, when he is desirous to eat (and finds what he needs)!; (Bab.

<cite ref="Pesachim 99b:2">Pes. 99ᵇ</cite> <he>כדי</he> … <he>כשהוא ת׳</he> Ar. a. Ms. M. 2 (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 5; ed. <he>כשהוא תאוה</he>, read: <cite ref="V00012"><he>תָּאֵו</he></cite>; Y. ib. X, beg. 37ᵇ <he>בתאוה</he>) that he may enter the Sabbath with an appetite (for food).

<cite ref="Yevamot 15a:6">Yeb. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>תָּאַבְנִי וכ׳</he> (marg. corr. <he>תאב אני</he>); <cite ref="Tosefta Yevamot 1:10">Tosef. ib. I, 10</cite> <he>תָּאַיבְנִי</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>ת׳ אני</he>) I wish that I had &c. Mekh. Mishp. s. 20 <he>עני ת׳</he> a poor man in great need, contrad. to <cite ref="D00797"><he>דל</he></cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>תְּאֵבִים</he>, <cite ref="V00027"><he>תְּאֵי׳</he></cite>.
